title: Strong law of large numbers for generalized operator means II
summary: In this paper we continue the investigation of generalizations of the strong law of large numbers to operator means which has been initiated in the earlier paper "Strong law of large numbers for generalized operator means", Adv. Math. 457 (2024), 109933 of the authors. In particular, we clarify an inaccuracy in the statement and proof of the strong law for means associated with uniformly exponentially contracting flows in Thompson metric spaces.
